questions.question: FDI stands for :
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Foreign Direct Investment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• FDI Stands for **Foreign Direct Investment**.
 
• It is an investment made by a firm or individual in one country into business interests located in another country.
 
• However, FID's are distinguished from portfolio investments in which an investor merely purchases equities of foreign-based companies.
 
• It plays an important role in the economic development of a country. 
 
• There are 3 types of FDI:
 
 
• **Horizontal FDI**
 
• **Vertical FDI**
 
• **Conglomerate FDI**
 
 
 
• **Horizontal FDI: **
 
 
• It is where funds are invested abroad in the same industry.
 
• In other words, a business invests in a foreign firm that produces similar goods.
 
• For example, a US-based firm may purchase Puma, a Germany-based firm.
 
• They are both in the industry of sportswear and therefore would be classified as a form of horizontal FDI.
 
 
 
• **Vertical FDI:-**
 
 
• Vertical FDI is where an investment is made within the supply chain, but not directly in the same industry.
 
• In other words, a business invests in a foreign firm that it may supply or sell too. For example, Hershey's, a US Manufacturer may look to invest in cocoa products in Brazil.
 
• This is known as backward vertical integration because the firm is purchasing a supplier, or potential supplier, in the supply chain.
 
 
 
• **Conglomerate FDI:**
 
 
• It is where an investment is made in a completely different industry. In other words, it is not linked in any direct way to the investor's business.
 
• For Example, Walmart, a US retailer, may invest in BMW, a German automobile manufacturer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• Diversification

• Tax Incentives
 
• Employment and Economic Boost
 
 
 
• **Disadvantages of FDI:**
 
 
• Foreign Control
 
• Loss of Domestic Jobs
 
• Risk of Political or Economic Change

questions.question: Two varieties of rice, A and B, costing Rs. 210 and Rs. 280 per kg respectively are mixed in the ratio of 3 ∶ 4. The mixed variety is sold at Rs. 260 per kg. What is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given**:

Cost of rice A = Rs. 210 per kg

Cost of rice B = Rs. 280 per kg

The selling price of the mixed variety of A and B = Rs. 260 per kg

Rice A and Rice B is mixed in the ratio = 3 ∶ 4

**Formula used:**

Ratio = (Dearer price – mean)/(mean – cheaper price);

Profit% = [(S.P – C.P)/C.P] × 100

**Calculation**:

Let the cost price of the mixture be Rs. 'x' 

⇒ 3/4 = (280 – x)/(x – 210)

⇒ 3x – 630 = 1120 – 4x

⇒ 3x + 4x = 1120 + 630

⇒ 7x = 1750

⇒ x = 250 

Profit% = [(260 - 250)/250] × 100 = 4%

**∴ The profit percentage is 4%. **

questions.question: The simple interest on a sum deposited at 8% p.a. for 8 years is Rs. 16,000. What will be the compound interest on the same sum at one fourth of the above rate of interest for 2 years?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total **Simple Interest** percentage = 8% × 8 years = 64%.

As per question, 64% → Rs. 16,000 ⇒ 1% = Rs. 250.

New **Rate of Interest** = 8% ÷ 4 = 2%.

Effective **Compound Interest** rate for 2 years at 2% = 2 + 2 + (2 × 2)/100 = 4.04%.

Required Compound Interest = 4.04 × 250 = Rs. 1,010.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1,010.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Simple Interest (SI)** = Rs. 16,000 | **Rate (R₁)** = 8% | **Time (T₁)** = 8 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

CI = P[(1 + R/100)ⁿ − 1]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f38b61790c6f13b12206088c8da385b9b788997924437cb93a758b86a08d106.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 16,000 = (P × 8 × 8) ÷ 100

⇒ 16,000 = 64P ÷ 100

⇒ P = (16,000 × 100) ÷ 64

⇒ **Principal (P)** = Rs. 25,000

⇒ New **Rate (R₂)** = 8% ÷ 4 = 2% p.a.

⇒ New **Time (n)** = 2 years

⇒ CI = 25,000 × [(1 + 2/100)² − 1]

⇒ CI = 25,000 × [(1.02)² − 1]

⇒ CI = 25,000 × [1.0404 − 1]

⇒ CI = 25,000 × 0.0404 = Rs. 1,010

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1,010.**

**__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for CI

For 2 years, the effective compound interest rate can be calculated using the formula: x + y + (xy/100), where x and y are the rates for the first and second year.

Difference between CI and SI

The difference between **Compound Interest** and **Simple Interest** for 2 years is given by: D = P(R/100)².

Amount in CI

The total **Amount (A)** after n years in compound interest is A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ.</p

questions.question: ______ cannot be corrected with spectacles.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cataract**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A** cataract **is a clouding of the lens, which prevents a clear, sharp image from being produced.
 
• A cataract forms because the lens is sealed in a capsule and as old cells die they get trapped in the capsule, with time this causes a clouding over of the lens, this clouding results in blurred images. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Presbyopia:**

 
 
• The power of accommodation of the eye usually decreases with aging.
 
• For most people, the near point gradually recedes away.
 
• They find it difficult to see nearby objects comfortably and distinctly without corrective eye-glasses.
 
• This defect is called presbyopia.
 
• It arises due to the gradual weakening of the ciliary muscles and diminishing flexibility of the eye lens.
 
 
 
• **Hypermetropia:**
 
 
• Hypermetropia is also known as** far-sightedness**.
 
• A person with hypermetropia can see distant objects clearly but cannot see nearby objects distinctly.
 
• This defect can be corrected by using a** convex lens** of appropriate power.
 
 
 
• **Myopia:**
 
 
• Myopia is also known as **near-sightedness**.
 
• A person with myopia can see nearby objects clearly but cannot see distant objects distinctly.
 
• A person with this defect has the far point nearer than infinity. Such a person may see clearly up to a distance of a few meters.
 
• In a myopic eye, the image of a distant object is formed in front of the retina and not at the retina itself. 
 
• This defect can be corrected by using a **concave lens** of suitable power.

2 × (3Y + 5) = 5Y + 25

questions.question: The areas of two similar triangles are 169 sq.cm. and 121 sq.cm. If the longest side of larger triangle is 26 cm, then the length of the longest side of the other triangle is ______.
questions.solution:
**Given**:

The areas of two similar triangles are 169 sq.cm. and 121 sq.cm and the longest side of larger triangle is 26 cm

**Concept Used**::

if two triangles are similar then their corresponding angles are congruent and corresponding areas are in proportion of square of their respective sides.

**Calculation**:

Let the length of the longest side of the other triangle is 'x'

⇒ 169/121 = 26²/x²

⇒ x² = 121 × 26²/169

⇒ x = 11 × 26/13

⇒ x = 22 cm

∴ required length of the longest side of the other triangle = 22 cm
